introduction: Before completing the TrendMart Retail investigation, submit your final business findings for manager review.
approvalMessage: Excellent investigation. Your conclusions are supported by the available evidence. TrendMart Retail has accepted your investigation.

questions.question: What is the most likely driver of the decline in repeat customers?
Which cities should be prioritised for the delivery recovery plan?
Which action best addresses the evidence?
options: Audit late-order handoffs and proactively communicate with affected customers
questions.correctAnswer: Audit late-order handoffs and proactively communicate with affected customers

questions.question: Enter the evidence theme that connects weak retention and customer complaints.

revealReport.heading: ROOT CAUSE
revealReport.content: Delivery delays are concentrated in the cities with the weakest repeat-customer retention.

revealReport.heading: EVIDENCE
revealReport.content: Those same cities also have the highest volume of late-delivery complaints.

revealReport.heading: PRIORITY AREA
revealReport.content: Prioritise Delhi and Mumbai for recovery work.

revealReport.heading: RECOMMENDATION
revealReport.content: Audit late-order handoffs, communicate proactively with affected customers, and monitor repeat purchase recovery weekly.
